title: Evaluation scheme for children-centered language interaction competence of AI-driven robots
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It evaluates the language interaction competence of AI-driven robots for children across five dimensions: interactivity, specificity, development (expansibility), sociality, and safety.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
